78.translation: From statements such as ‘to those who are constantly joined, who worship Me with love, I give that yoga of understanding by which they come to Me’ and ‘My devotee, knowing this, becomes fit for My state,’ it has been said that knowledge of reality itself is devotion.
word_for_word: teṣāṃ satata-yuktānāṃ bhajatāṃ prīti-pūrvakam dadāmi buddhi-yogaṃ taṃ yena mām upayānti te
